title.narrative: Strengthening Local and Indigenous Knowledge Systems in Pacific SIDS

description.narrative: UNESCO Pacific Office strengthens the recognition, safeguarding, and application of indigenous and local knowledge systems in Pacific SIDS through UNESCO’s LINKS Programme. It promotes collaboration between indigenous knowledge holders, scientists, and policymakers to support inclusive, transdisciplinary approaches to development. Key actions include documenting and transmitting traditional knowledge, integrating it into education and policy frameworks, and fostering participatory platforms for dialogue and knowledge exchange. Through regional partnerships and capacity development, UNESCO Pacific Office will enhance the role of indigenous knowledge in addressing climate change, biodiversity conservation, and disaster risk, enabling culturally grounded, locally driven solutions for resilience and sustainable development.
